---
title: "Your reading stats"
toc: false
---

StoryGraph's free tier keeps a lot of your reading history to itself. Storywell reads your
own library export and turns it into a richer picture — years of reading, your moods and
pace, the characters you gravitate towards — as a single page you can keep, print, or share.

You don't need to install anything or run a terminal. The dashboard below starts with a
small **sample library** so you can see what you'll get; load your own export and it's
rebuilt **entirely in your browser** — your library never leaves your device.

## Load your library

1. In StoryGraph, open **Manage Account → Export StoryGraph Library** and download the
   `.csv` file (StoryGraph emails you a link when it's ready).
2. Click below and pick that file. The first load fetches a small Python runtime; after
   that your dashboard appears in a moment.

```{=html}
<div class="dash-loader">
  <label class="dash-btn">
    <input type="file" accept=".csv,text/csv" id="storywell-file" hidden>
    Load my StoryGraph export…
  </label>
  <span id="storywell-status" class="dash-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Showing example data.</span>
</div>
```

::: column-page
```{=html}
<iframe id="storywell-dash" class="dashboard-frame" src="assets/dashboard/example.html" title="Reading-stats dashboard" loading="lazy" onload="storywellFitFrame(this)"></iframe>
```
:::

```{=html}
<style>
  .dashboard-frame{
    width:100%; min-height:640px; border:1px solid var(--bs-border-color,#cdd3da);
    border-radius:12px; background:#0f1620; display:block;
  }
  .dash-loader{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:1rem 0 1.5rem}
  .dash-btn{
    display:inline-block;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;padding:.55rem 1.1rem;border-radius:10px;
    background:var(--bs-link-color,#b9742f);color:#fff;border:1px solid transparent;
  }
  .dash-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
  .dash-status{color:var(--bs-secondary-color,#6c757d);font-size:.92rem}
  .dash-status[data-kind="busy"]::before{content:"⏳ "}
  .dash-status[data-kind="ok"]{color:#2f8f5b}
  .dash-status[data-kind="error"]{color:#c0392b}
</style>
<script>
  function storywellFitFrame(frame){
    try{
      const doc = frame.contentWindow.document;
      frame.style.height = doc.documentElement.scrollHeight + "px";
    }catch(e){ /* not ready yet — keep the min-height */ }
  }
  addEventListener("resize", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".dashboard-frame").forEach(storywellFitFrame);
  });
</script>
<script src="dashboard.js" defer></script>
```
